```sql
select
  null as key,
  cast(
    sum(case when a.status = 'captured' then 1 else 0 end) * 1.0
    / nullif(count(*), 0)
    as decimal(38,12)
  ) as value
from payment_attempts a
join orders o on o.order_id = a.order_id
join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
join cities ci on ci.city_id = s.city_id
where not a.is_test
  and not o.is_test
  and s.region_id in ('IN-TN')
  and ci.name = 'Chennai'
  and a.method = 'upi'
  and a.business_date between date '2026-08-31' and date '2026-09-06'
order by value
```
